# PKM Neo4j Service Project

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Python (PyCharm) project with FastAPI services, scripts, commands, and agents that support the PKM system.

**Also known as:** pkm-neo4j-service

## Scope note

Includes Python services for Calendar, Health, Graph, Obsidian, Recipe, and Review.

- [PKM Python Services](../PKMPythonServices/)
